card.name: Words just before church or denomination names
card.fires_on: Linking words and name starts right before a religious body is named, such as a Baptist, Methodist, Episcopal, Jewish or Hindu group, in web text about religion.

modes.label: Before a denomination name
modes.description: A small linking word or first name part comes just before a named church, faith or congregation.
modes.example: presiding bishop<< of>> the Episcopal Church, Chief Rabbi Lord Jonathan

modes.label: Religious role or place words
modes.description: Words like minister or synagogue that lead into a named religious body or its description.
modes.example: He is a retired<< minister>> in the United Methodist Church.

modes.label: Citation lists
modes.description: Names or dashes in reference lists about church bodies.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward church and religious-community words such as Pastor, church and congregation.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to name a church, faith group or congregation.
